package config

import "testing"

func TestLoadRejectsSharedPlannerWriteToken(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN", "shared-token")
	t.Setenv("LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "shared-token")
	if _, err := Load(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected identical general and Planner tokens to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestLoadAllowsDisabledPlannerWriteRoute(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN", "general-token")
	t.Setenv("LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "")
	config, err := Load()
	if err != nil || config.LearningPlannerInternalToken != "" {
		t.Fatalf("load config: config=%#v err=%v", config, err)
	}
}

func TestLoadRejectsDiagnosticCatalogTokenEqualToAnyOtherInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN", "general-token")
	t.Setenv("LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "planner-token")
	for _, value := range []string{"general-token", "planner-token"} {
		t.Setenv("DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN", value)
		if _, err := Load(); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected diagnostic token %q to be rejected", value)
		}
	}
}

func TestLoadAllowsDisabledDiagnosticCatalogRoute(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN", "general-token")
	t.Setenv("LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "planner-token")
	t.Setenv("DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "")
	config, err := Load()
	if err != nil || config.DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken != "" {
		t.Fatalf("load config: config=%#v err=%v", config, err)
	}
}

func TestLoadReadsOptionalHTTPHost(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HTTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
	config, err := Load()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load config: %v", err)
	}
	if config.HTTPHost != "127.0.0.1" {
		t.Fatalf("HTTPHost = %q, want loopback host", config.HTTPHost)
	}
}
